entries.name: Nothing a date or clock column publishes names one of its outer cells
entries.rule: over the tail design's own battery -- twenty-one shapes at two sizes and up to three seeds, 105 cases, each through the real producer, generator and checker at a floor of eleven -- `literal` is 0: no published value, summary line or report line is equal, token for token, to one of the eleven outermost values of the real column, the column ordered by its OWN role (a clock column by `parsing.clock_ordinal` against its published `clock_form`, because reading it with the ISO-date parser gave an EMPTY set of outermost values and this number could then not fail on any clock shape). `pinned` is 0: no tail's published rows, mean and root-mean-square distance name its OUTERMOST VALUE and how many rows hold it -- which is the question since the governance pass of stage 3's review (item 3), where asking for ONE multiset instead scored nought on eleven distances summing to 24 with squares 104, two multisets that BOTH put the largest at 8 with one row on it. `missed` is 0 -- no checkable obligation is missed on any twin or any real table of the battery -- so a zero here cannot be bought by a description that says nothing. A tail's own `values` are not counted against `literal` where the LISTING RULE admits them -- `taxonomy.tail_may_list` asked of the column's own cells beyond that boundary -- and that is the WHOLE exemption since plan P4-D349 withdrew the second road, which had exempted a tail of at most `TAIL_SETTLED_VALUES` values whatever the rule said. THE EXEMPTION WAS MEMBERSHIP UNTIL P4-D346, so this could not go non-zero on a drifted listing rule. A member's fixed example is not counted either. `cases`, `listed` and `window` are at_least, so the battery may not shrink, the values-publishing tail may not stop being exercised, and the distance between the tightest tail and a leak may not close. THREE CEILINGS STATE WHAT IS NOT CLAIMED AWAY, each defined in plan P4-D343 and measured by the driver: `equality_only`, the real table's own distances that meet G12.14 only by exact equality; `edge_pinned`, the shape-drawn tails a reader settles to ONE arithmetic by also using the column's `every value different` remark and the tail's own edge -- a ceiling at NOUGHT since P4-D346, which moves such a boundary inward until a second multiset fits; and `unsearched`, the tails whose walk could not finish and which are therefore counted as UNMEASURED rather than roomy. The producer's guard `taxonomy._tail_pinned` takes the opposite default (budget spent means pinned, P4-D329): each defaults to the answer that cannot flatter the landing.
entries.measured_on: the tail design's battery and the shapes its skeptic added: twenty-one shapes at 400 and 1,500 rows (900 where a clock's own day has no room for more), seeds 0, 4 and 11, floor 11
entries.evidence: RE-MEASURED AT THE CLOSE OF STAGE 3'S REVIEW under a SHARPER measurement and every one of the nine numbers came back: 105 cases, literal 0, pinned 0, missed 0, edge_pinned 0, equality_only 2, listed 12, window 2, unsearched 35. The back-solve now asks whether the tail's outermost value and its count vary across the multisets its facts admit, and the literal sweep joins adjacent tokens and strips a trailing point, so a moment printed after a label and a clock value at the end of a sentence are compared whole (items 3 and 4). ON THE TREE THAT CLOSED STAGE 3 (P4-D346). 105 cases: 0 published values, summary lines or report lines equal to one of the eleven outermost values of the real column, 0 tails settled by the plain back-solve, 0 checkable obligations missed -- and the exemption that lets `literal` read 0 is the listing rule's own conditions now, not membership, so the number can fail on a rule that moves. MUTATION: with `tail_may_list` forced open the driver reads 22, 11, 22 and 11 leaked values on the four clock cases of 900 rows, against 0 as this tree ships it. 12 tails over 8 cases list their values: seven of quarters and months, each held by 3 to 14 cells, and five of the `0001-01-01` heap. `edge_pinned` IS 0 against 4 on the merged tree: the four sides that carried it -- one each of `clock_all_different` and `clock_edges` at 900 rows, seeds 0 and 4 -- move their boundary inward until a second multiset fits, 11 rows a side becoming 15 or 17 of 900, and the walk must PROVE the tail settled inside its budget or nothing moves. `window` is still 2, `unsearched` 35 and `equality_only` 2.

At a floor of eleven the walk puts 12,724 published numbers into VALUE 4,817, INDEX 1,997, SETTLED 1,895, GROUP 1,706, STRUCTURAL 1,616, POOLED 310, DISTINCT 294 and WRITTEN_FORM 89, beside the sentence arguments and the two words a count moves. 38 date and clock tails are put to the back-solve across the three floors and NONE is settled to one arithmetic. FIVE MUTATIONS prove the gate can fail, each a test of its own and each PINNED here so it cannot be deleted with this entry still green: a level count re-published at 1, a sentence argument one greater than its key, the column's exact minimum put back into percentiles.min, a tail listing three values one row holds apiece, and parsing.POPULATION_FLOOR halved. entries.status_note: ACCEPTED BY THE OWNER ON 2026-09-23 (plan P4-D348) and NOT to be re-asked. The disclosure floor counts rows, so on a repeated-measures table a value held by twelve visits of ONE patient is published with its count. The other half of stage 3 -- the POPULATION floor of P4-D340 and P4-D341 -- already counts PEOPLE: 500 visits over 99 patients is refused. The two halves count different units on purpose, and this entry is the statement of what that leaves standing. Counting the disclosure floor in people would change what every column of every repeated-measures table publishes, which is a landing and not a clause. tests/test_stage3_gate.py::test_the_floor_counts_rows_and_not_people_which_the_owner_accepted fails if the limit CLOSES, so a landing that closes it cannot leave this entry standing unread.

entries.phase_stage: Stage 3, the fix pass of 2026-09-23 (plan P4-D349)
entries.name: What the withheld tail pair costs the twin
entries.rule: over the eight reconstruction attacks of tests/test_stage3_gate.py and the two shapes beside them -- 399 consecutive record numbers with one far value and the same column without it -- at a floor of eleven, count the tail SIDES that publish neither distance, and count every checkable obligation their twins MISS at seeds 0 and 4 together. The second number may not rise: a side withheld is a side whose rows are read through the column's own published mean and spread, and a twin that misses more than the far-value shape's two moments is a reading that has stopped working rather than a limit that was accepted
entries.measured_on: tests/test_stage3_gate.py::withheld_cost, ten single-column shapes at a floor of eleven, each described, generated at seeds 0 and 4 and checked
entries.evidence: 17 tail sides over 10 shapes publish neither distance, and their twins miss FOUR obligations in total -- `moments.mean` and `moments.std`, at both seeds, on ONE shape: 399 consecutive record numbers `00001` to `00399` beside a single `12345`. Every other shape's twin misses nothing, the same column with `00400` in place of the far value among them, so the cost is the far value and not the withholding. WHY IT CANNOT BE REPAIRED BY A BETTER READING: three were measured (plan P4-D349). `rows` grid steps past the boundary, which is what ships, reaches 400; `mean + sqrt(3) std` reaches 1301; Cauchy-Schwarz's own bound on the mean of `m` of `K` cells reaches 3745. The first two undershoot the column's mean of 230.3625 and the third overshoots it, because that mean IS what the far cell puts in it -- so no construction that keeps the cell back can average to it. THE READING THAT SHIPS IS THE NARROWEST AND IT IS ALSO THE MOST FAITHFUL ELSEWHERE: on the integers 0 to 1100 the twin's two ends are 0.0 and 1100.0, the column's own, and on 200 `1 000`-`1 199` beside 100 `3 000`-`3 099` the published census of 200 spaces and 100 narrow spaces comes back exactly, where the moment reading put twelve cells below 1000 and held 89 of the 100. The twin's own report names both deviations of the far-value shape and the quality report reports them MISSED, so nothing here is silent.
entries.status_note: ACCEPTED AS A LIMIT BY THE FIX PASS OF STAGE 3 (plan P4-D349), and it is the price of closing the review's exact reconstruction. Before the pass, a tail whose published rows, mean and root-mean-square distance -- read with the column's own `every value different` remark -- left ONE multiset of distances published that pair anyway, and every one of its outer cells came back exactly. It now publishes its boundary and its rows and neither distance. On a column whose withheld tail carries the whole of its spread that costs the twin the column's exact mean and spread, and three readings of a withheld tail were measured before that was accepted, which the owner's two mandatory goals will not let anybody pretend is nothing: it is recorded here, named in the twin's own report, and the shape it happens to is stated. Closing it would take publishing something about the tail, which is the thing this pass withdrew.
